title: Galaxy on Fire 2 HD
notes: A clean physical-device run reaches the title, menu and a fresh combat scene. The skybox, planets, HUD, dialogue and engine exhaust render, but the player ship body is absent. The observed scene ran at roughly 17–18 FPS. Program-binary and PVRTC RGBA8 disk caches load without a crash, rejected binary or out-of-memory error; the remaining fault is being traced in the ship material/draw path.
